decisive_items: novel heterozygous missense variant, c.6832G>T, p.Gly2278Trp, in COL7A1 (NM_000094)
response.rationale: COL7A1 variant and dermoepidermal separation specifically indicate dystrophic EB, more precise than generic inherited EB.

rejected.why: No genetic evidence; clinical pattern and chronicity favor inherited rather than acquired EB.
